claim.label: take-off speed
claim.provenance: Supplementary Dataset S3, sheet 'Regius', row S/N 11: gap x = 60 mm, y = 0 mm; take-off velocity 0.952 m/s, take-off angle 26.5 deg, time to take-off 20.625 ms. No uncertainty is published. Methods: the nominal centre of mass was tracked in Phantom PCC 2.7 and the ballistic velocity and angle were chosen to minimise the RMS deviation from the trajectory.
